scientific_integrity: Claims established by component-by-component intersection theory, exact characteristic-zero polynomial-matrix ranks, and explicitly indexed determinant certificates; arithmetic samples alone are not used as proof. The originating examples and freeness of the base are attributed to their authors.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to the smooth nonzero-parameter conic pencil over the complex numbers. Only minimal syzygy degree and the degree-four and degree-five spaces are determined, not full graded Betti tables or arbitrary conic additions. Historical literature may contain an unindexed overlap.
title: Collision and Jacobian-jumping strata of a conic-addition pencil
